text: Both review labels now exist in AccentureCodeFoundry/314092_agent-execution-environment: `ready-to-merge` (green #0e8a16, created during PR #519) and `revisions-required` (orange #d93f0b, created during PR #520). Use them; don't recreate.

Repo isolation model (relevant to reviewing seeding/migration changes): default deployment is a shared pool volume with per-agent SubPath mounts, so orchestrator writes to /workspace/agents/<id>/ are directly visible to the agent container. Opt-in `AEE_PER_AGENT_VOLUME=1` gives each agent a dedicated volume that is authoritative; `seedPerAgentVolume` only copies into an EMPTY dst, and updates require an explicit `reseedPerAgentVolume` (only runs for a *running* agent). Any change touching CLAUDE.md/AGENT-PROMPT.md/skills seeding must handle BOTH modes.

PR reviews via `gh pr review` post under the shared PAT identity `thorsten-a-maier_accent` and show as state COMMENTED; agent attribution comes only from the `gh-as-agent stamp` marker, not the GitHub author.
